author: Manage Bet Codes
description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Manage Bet Codes API v1
name: managebetcodes-mcp

prompts.name: convert-to-all-bookmakers
prompts.description: Convert one booking code to all supported bookmakers and summarize every new code and any unmappable games.

arguments.name: targets
arguments.description: Optional comma-separated target bookmakers (omit for all)

prompts.name: bulk-convert-codes
prompts.description: Bulk convert 2 to 4 booking codes across all or selected bookmakers.

arguments.name: codes_list
arguments.description: List of codes with bookmakers, e.g. 'sportybet:7B9A2F, bet9ja:B9JA12'

prompts.name: split-slip
prompts.description: Split one booking code into 2 to 20 smaller codes using Equal, By batches, Target odds, or Custom counts.

arguments.name: method
arguments.description: Split method: equal, by_batches, target_odds, or custom

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Number of codes (2-20), target odds (e.g. 5.0), or custom game counts (e.g. 3,3,2)

prompts.name: build-slip-from-text
prompts.description: Resolve natural-language games into a 10-minute plan and book a verified code.

arguments.name: picks_text
arguments.description: Games and markets to book (e.g. 'Arsenal vs Chelsea Over 2.5, Real Madrid to win')

resources.name: Supported Bookmakers & Capabilities
resources.description: All 29 bookmakers, canonical keys, aliases, code regex hints, and capability flags.

resources.name: Canonical Market & Outcome Catalog
resources.description: Canonical market names and valid outcome identifiers for resolving and booking games.

resources.name: API Manifest, Prices & Limits
resources.description: Machine-readable manifest of routes, credit prices, limits, and enums.

resources.name: Caller Plan, Credits & Rate Limits
resources.description: Current API credit balance, regular daily credit balance, charge_order, and active limits.

tools.name: mbc_list_bookmakers
tools.title: List Supported Bookmakers
tools.description: List all 29 supported bookmakers with their canonical keys, aliases, code format hints, and capability flags (supports_book, supports_search, supports_tracking, supports_split, conversion_mode). Costs 0 credits. Note: bare '1xbet' and 'afropari' are retired; use '1xng'/'1xglobal' and 'afropari_ng'/'afropari_global'.

tools.name: mbc_list_markets
tools.title: List Canonical Betting Markets
tools.description: List all canonical betting markets (1X2, Over/Under, Both Teams To Score, Double Chance, Asian Handicap, European Handicap, totals) and their valid outcome names for resolving and booking games. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_get_usage
tools.title: Check API Plan, Credits & Rate Limits
tools.description: Read the caller's active plan, key charge_order, API credits (monthly plan plus never-expiring packs), regular daily credits, rate limit windows, and active jobs and tracks. Costs 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_view_slip
tools.title: View Bet Slip (JSON & Text)
tools.description: Load a booking code on a bookmaker and return all games, markets, outcomes, odds, live scores, kickoff times, and total odds. Costs 1 credit after a successful read; failed lookups cost 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_view_slip_image
tools.title: Render Bet Slip Image (PNG)
tools.description: Render a branded PNG slip image for a booking code on a bookmaker. Returns an MCP ImageContent block (image/png) plus a summary. Costs 2 credits after a successful render; failed renders cost 0 credits.

tools.name: mbc_convert_code
tools.title: Convert Bet Code (1 to 6 Targets)
tools.description: Convert a booking code from one source bookmaker to 1 target bookmaker or a synchronous batch of up to 6 target bookmakers. Costs 2 credits per target that produces a code; failed targets are automatically refunded. To convert to all bookmakers at once (up to 27), use mbc_convert_to_all.

to_bookmakers.description: Target bookmaker key/alias or list of 1 to 6 targets (e.g. '1xng' or ['1xng', 'bet9ja', 'msport']).

tools.name: mbc_convert_to_all
tools.title: Convert One Bet Code to All Bookmakers
tools.description: Convert one booking code to ALL supported target bookmakers at once (up to 27 target bookmakers: SportyBet, 1xBet Global, 1xBet NG, MSport, Paripesa, 22Bet, Megapari, 888starz, Afropari NG, Afropari Global, Betwinner, Melbet, Helabet, Fastpari, Xparibet, Goldpari, 1xBit, WinWinBet, DBBet, Paripulse, BetJam, Planbet, Linebet, Luckypari, Bet9ja, BetKing, Football.com), or pass a custom targets subset. Uses per-family concurrency lanes. Costs 2 credits per successful target code; failed targets cost 0 credits.

targets.description: Optional list of target bookmaker keys. Omit to convert to all eligible bookmakers.

include_card.description: Set true to also render a PNG share card with all converted codes (1080 px wide, as tall as the content).

tools.name: mbc_bulk_convert
tools.title: Bulk Convert Multiple Bet Codes
tools.description: Convert 2 to 4 source booking codes synchronously across all or selected target bookmakers in one batch (each slip's own source bookmaker is automatically excluded from its targets). Costs 2 credits per successful (code, target) pair; failed pairs cost 0 credits. For 5 to 20 source codes, use mbc_manage_jobs_and_history with action='create_job' and kind='convert'.

codes.description: 2 to 4 source slips to bulk convert.

targets.description: Optional target bookmaker keys. Omit to convert each slip to all eligible bookmakers.

include_card.description: Set true to render a combined PNG share card containing all slips (1080 px wide, as tall as the content).

tools.name: mbc_split_code
tools.title: Split Bet Code Into 2–20 Codes
tools.description: Divide one booking code into 2 to 20 smaller codes on the same bookmaker so every game lands in exactly one new code. Supports 4 split methods: 'equal' (spread games evenly across codes), 'by_batches' (keep consecutive games together in each code), 'target_odds' (group games to reach a chosen combined odds per code), and 'custom' (set exact game counts per output code). Supports 2 game orders: 'mixed' (keep original slip order) and 'by_start_time' (earliest games first, latest games last). Costs 2 credits plus 1 credit per extra created code; unused parts are refunded.

order.description: Game order: 'mixed' (original slip order) or 'by_start_time' (sorted by kickoff).

count.description: Number of output codes (2 to 20) when method is 'equal' or 'by_batches'.

target_odds.description: Target combined odds per output code (e.g. 5.0) when method is 'target_odds'.

counts.description: Exact game count for each output code (must sum to total games on the slip) when method is 'custom'.

tools.name: mbc_merge_codes
tools.title: Merge 2–30 Bet Codes Into One
tools.description: Combine 2 to 30 booking codes (from the same or different bookmakers) into one deduplicated booking code on a target bookmaker. Reports any skipped, dropped, or conflicting games. Costs 2 credits for 2 codes plus 1 credit per extra input code; refunded if no code is created.

target.description: Target bookmaker key or alias (defaults to the first pair's bookmaker).

tools.name: mbc_search_events
tools.title: Search Bookmaker Events & Fixtures
tools.description: Search up to 20 team or head-to-head match queries ('Arsenal vs Chelsea', 'Real Madrid') on a bookmaker. Returns event IDs, kickoff times, confidence ('exact' or 'fuzzy'), and top canonical markets. Costs 0 action credits (counts against daily search cap).

q.description: Team name ('Arsenal') or head-to-head ('Arsenal vs Chelsea').

sport.description: Sport filter (default 'football'; pass 'all' for all sports).

include_markets.description: Include top canonical markets on each event (default true).

market_filter.description: Optional canonical market names to filter (e.g. ['1X2', 'Over/Under']).

tools.name: mbc_get_event_markets
tools.title: Get All Markets & Odds for an Event
tools.description: Fetch all available canonical markets, lines, outcomes, and live odds for one event_id on a bookmaker. Costs 0 action credits.

tools.name: mbc_resolve_picks
tools.title: Resolve Games Into a 10-Minute Booking Plan
tools.description: Validate 1 to 50 games (team names or event_ids plus canonical market, outcome, and optional line/odds) on a target bookmaker and create a 10-minute plan_id for mbc_book_code. Returns per-game status ('resolved', 'ambiguous', 'not_found', 'market_missing', 'odds_changed', 'not_bookable'). Costs 0 action credits.

market.description: Canonical market (e.g. '1X2', 'Over/Under', 'Both Teams To Score', 'Double Chance').

strict.description: Require all games to resolve (default true).

accept_odds_change.description: Accept moved odds beyond 1% tolerance (default false).

tools.name: mbc_book_code
tools.title: Book a New Bet Code From Plan or Picks
tools.description: Mint a new verified booking code on 1 to 6 target bookmakers from either a plan_id (from mbc_resolve_picks) or direct picks. Costs 2 credits per target code created; refunded if no code is created.

bookmaker.description: Primary target bookmaker key or alias (e.g. 'sportybet').

picks.description: Direct game picks when booking without a plan_id.

to.description: Optional fan-out list of 1 to 6 target bookmakers.

strict.description: All games must resolve or no code is created (default true).

accept_odds_change.description: Allow booking if odds moved since resolution (default false).

tools.name: mbc_manage_tracking
tools.title: Start, Inspect, List, or Stop Live Tracking
tools.description: Manage live match tracking for SportyBet, Football.com, and Betway slips. Actions: 'start' (costs 1 credit; mode 'ticket' fast-fails on a cut, 'game' tracks to the end), 'get' (0 credits), 'list' (0 credits), 'stop' (0 credits).

mode.description: 'ticket' (fast-fail on a losing game) or 'game' (track all games to the end).

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL on port 443/8443 for 'start'.

tools.name: mbc_manage_jobs_and_history
tools.title: Manage Bulk Jobs & Query Conversion / Book History
tools.description: Create, inspect, list, or cancel async jobs (for >6 targets or up to 20 source codes, requires Developer/Scale/Business API plan), or query past conversion history and book history (0 credits for reads).

job_id.description: Job ID 'job_...' for get_job or cancel_job.

row_id.description: History ID ('hl_...') or Book ID for get_history or get_book.
